sn1.7:1.2: Standing to one side, a devatā addressed the Blessed One with a verse:
sn1.7:2.2:
who may be led
by the teachings of others:
sn1.7:2.3:
Asleep are they;
they haven’t awakened.
sn1.7:2.4:
It’s time for them
to awaken.”
sn1.7:3.1:
The Buddha:
“Those in whom
phenomena are well-penetrated,
sn1.7:3.2:
may not be led
by the teachings of others.
sn1.7:3.4:
they go among the discordant
harmoniously.”
